_README: Featured projects for the highlight section within Active Sites. These are your biggest/most impressive projects that deserve special storytelling treatment.

featuredProjects.name: 3 Healdsburg
featuredProjects.description: A landmark multi-family development project in the heart of downtown Healdsburg. This large-scale site development encompasses comprehensive pad development, utility infrastructure, and concrete foundation work, setting a new standard for urban residential construction in Sonoma County.
highlights: Large-scale site development with precision grading

timeline.title: Site Preparation
timeline.description: Comprehensive land clearing, grading, and pad development to prepare the site for construction.

timeline.title: Utility Infrastructure
timeline.description: Installation of complete wet and dry utility systems including water, sewer, electrical, and gas.

timeline.title: Foundation & Concrete
timeline.description: Extensive foundation work, slab preparation, and concrete installation for all structures.

timeline.title: Final Phase
timeline.description: Curb, gutter, and street improvements, final site work, and project completion.

featuredProjects.name: Hembree Lane Oaks
featuredProjects.description: A master-planned residential subdivision development featuring comprehensive land clearing, grading, and infrastructure installation. This project showcases our expertise in large-scale residential development with precision site work and attention to detail.

timeline.title: Land Clearing & Grading
timeline.description: Comprehensive land clearing, site grading, and pad development for the entire subdivision.

timeline.title: Infrastructure Development
timeline.description: Construction of access roads, drainage systems, and utility infrastructure throughout the development.

timeline.title: Foundation Work
timeline.description: Foundation and concrete work for residential structures across all lots.

timeline.title: Completion
timeline.description: Final site improvements, landscaping preparation, and project completion.

featuredProjects.name: 388 S Marigold Ave
featuredProjects.description: A complete fire rebuild project demonstrating our expertise in residential construction. From initial pad development through foundation work, utility installation, and security systems, this project represents our commitment to rebuilding communities with care and precision.

timeline.title: Site Assessment & Planning
timeline.description: Comprehensive site assessment, planning, and permit acquisition for the rebuild project.

timeline.title: Pad Development
timeline.description: Site preparation, grading, and pad development to prepare for foundation work.

timeline.title: Foundation & Utilities
timeline.description: Foundation installation, utility connections, and curb & gutter work.

timeline.title: Final Installation
timeline.description: Security systems, fence installation, and final site improvements.
